scope: Theorem 6.6 (Local expectations are linear in the number of holes) of the manuscript “Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap” (preprints/Uniform-Stability-of-the-Spherical-Laughlin-Gap-October-5-2026/uniform-stability-spherical-laughlin-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1bb20744f2bfa51), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let q = 3(N − 1) and let W be a neutral Hermitian interaction whose center density and rapid locality bounds are uniform in q. For every unit vector ψ ∈ Zn,q, ⟨W⟩ψ − ⟨W⟩Laughlin,N ≤ CW (N − n). (6.25) For interactions supported in radius r with local norm at most one, CW is bounded by C(1 + r)B for a fixed exponent B. The same conclusion holds for zero-mode density matrices by linearity, with the expected value of N − N on the right.
